relevance_note: The paper tabulates four individuals with LAMP2 variants and Danon disease, e.g. "| Proband 1 | LAMP2 (c.64 + 1G > A) |".
method_note: Cardiac MRI cohort of 107 HCM-phenotype patients; only the four LAMP2 carriers in Table 1 (Proband 1 and his mother Subject 1, Family 1; Proband 2 and her mother Subject 2, Family 2) are in scope; PRKAG2, TTR, negative-genotype and sarcomeric patients get no rows. A Python script assembled the JSON from Table 1 rows that I transcribed and checked by hand against the table. Table 1 'Age (Year)' is recorded as age at last evaluation (age at study assessment; not stated as onset or diagnosis). Inheritance 'inherited maternal' for both probands rests on Table 1 giving the mothers (Subject 1/2, identified as 'the patient’s mother' in the Figure 1/2 captions) the same LAMP2 variant; the paper never states parental testing explicitly. Left ventricular hypertrophy/HCM phenotype is inferred from group statements describing the rare-disease patients as having phenotypic HCM (study defines HCM phenotype as LV wall thickness >=15 mm, >=13 mm in relatives); Subject 2's Max LVT is 14 mm. LVEF values (e.g. 16.9% for Subject 1) and T1/ECV values are not described as abnormal per person, so no reduced-EF item was marked. 'NSR' (normal sinus rhythm) excludes nothing more specific and was not recorded. NYHA class I for Proband 2 not recorded as a feature. 'Syncope History: No' recorded as syncope excluded. 'ICD implantation recommendation' (Proband 2) recorded as written in treatment_summary although it is a recommendation. Proband 2's LGE pattern is said to be 'consistent with our previous publication (Figure 2) [30]' but the paper does not state that the patient was previously reported, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. Minor inconsistency: Discussion says the female LGE was 'mainly in the anterior and lateral wall' whereas Results/Table 1 say lateral wall. No stacked cells.
